title: Final Fantasy Resonance is great... but I wish it had auto-battle and 2x/4x speeds. So I built those features into a new mech jrpg game I am prototyping
author: Comet7777
selftext:
This is sort of the mind-blowingly cool thing about this tech stack, you can just prototype a system that's fun for you and decide if it's worth building a full game on it. I'm a product of the 90s and early 2000s and I fucking love Gundam Wing and the old Final Fantasy games. To me, this prototype is a marriage of those ideas - except favoring more of a Golden Sun battle system. I'm aware of Chained Echoes and a few other games, but there really isn't a ton of JRPGs with mech stuff like this. So I said why not?

Using Claude Opus 5.5 along with [PixelLab.ai](http://PixelLab.ai) for my animations. You can also follow my YouTube channel where I'm building this game in public here: [https://youtu.be/NsT2nxWOu\_w](https://youtu.be/NsT2nxWOu_w)
